record.paper: On Borodin-Kostochka conjecture for correspondence coloring

dossier_meta.paper: On Borodin-Kostochka conjecture for correspondence coloring
dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the smallest number $\Delta_{0}$ such that every graph $G$ with $\Delta(G)\geq\Delta_{0}$ and $\omega(G)=\Delta(G)-1$ satisfies $\chi(G)=\chi_{\ell}(G)=\chi_{DP}(G)$?
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 4 of this paper gives an upper bound $\Delta_0 \leq 3\cdot 10^9$ for the correspondence coloring analogue. The equality $\chi(G)=\chi_\ell(G)=\chi_{DP}(G)$ clearly holds for all graphs $G$ with $\omega(G)=\Delta(G)+1$, and the parameters also coincide for graphs with $\omega(G)=\Delta(G)$; the smallest threshold $\Delta_0$ for the case $\omega(G)=\Delta(G)-1$ remains unknown.
